name: openbb_etf_holdings
description:
Holdings of one ETF through the OpenBB Platform (obb.etf.holdings).
Returns: {symbol, provider, data_points (all holdings), truncated, holdings: records with symbol, name, weight, shares, value} or {symbol, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ETF ticker); limit (holdings returned; default 50); provider (fmp, intrinio; default fmp).
Weights: openbb_etf_sectors, openbb_etf_countries; fund facts: openbb_etf_info. Keys: fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY; intrinio needs a key in ~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json.
Example: {"symbol": "QQQ", "limit": 25}

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
